mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for 3 consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek higher returns in equities.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% annually and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS annual growth > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over the past month signals a rapidly expanding labor market, which is a strong indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a strong economic growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
